structural_blocker.reason: Automated agent environment cannot perform verifiable human/legal review of external Binance Vision/Binance market-data terms. Recording permissions without verifiable review evidence would be fabrication (forbidden).
structural_blocker.blocked_by: requires human-maintainer/legal review with verifiable evidence capture

required_verifiable_evidence_fields.requirement: Exact URL of terms page reviewed (e.g., Binance Vision/data-use/market-data terms).
UTC date/time the reviewer accessed the terms.
Version identifier, effective date, or archived/snapshot identifier if available; otherwise 'not_provided_by_source' with explanation.

Factual summary of clauses relevant to: research use of historical market data, retention/redistribution of derived checksums/manifests in a public repository, and any attribution/restriction requirements.
Human maintainer/legal reviewer role; agent-only review is insufficient.
List conditions/restrictions or empty list with justification.
Optional archived snapshot paths/hashes/URLs; no fabricated artifacts.

resolution_rule: Do NOT set status=RESOLVED_VERIFIED or confirmatory_provenance_go/admissibility_complete true until all required fields are populated with verifiable facts, fabricated=false, human review recorded, and FCLR-014/v5 guard+validator accept. Any confirmatory outcomes on unprovenanced/incomplete 2025+ remain prohibited.
